test_lora: test lora adapter scaling by sending POST to /lora-adapters and /completion endpoints with scale 0.0 or 1.0
test_lora_per_request: test per-request lora scaling by sending parallel POST /completion requests with different lora scales
test_with_big_model: test lora adapters on a large 8B model by configuring ServerProcess with Llama-3.1-8B and abliteration LoRA
create_server_fixture: create a pytest fixture that initializes ServerPreset.stories15m_moe and downloads a LoRA file from HuggingFace
configure_lora_scale: configure lora adapter scale via POST /lora-adapters with id and scale parameters for global or per-request application
